description: Red de WiFi público de Reus is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by opendata.reus.cat. WiFi Reus is a dataset where you can find two datasets; one refering to the location of the connection points in the municipality, and other pertinent to the uses of Wi-Fi in municipal facilities. Both sets are presented in CSV, JSON and XML format and can be downloaded. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Public WiFi network of Reus" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Reus, WiFi, Wi-Fi. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
